notes: As of Update 10, shalks have a chance to drop beetle scuttle.
Although described as a type of shalk, the dire ash beetle Ash-Eater has the appearance of an assassin beetle.
related_quests: Blood and Sand: Help a Dwemer researcher recover her notes on a Dwemer artifact.
Can't Take It With Them: Help prevent the return of a malevolent minor Daedra.
Fires of Battle: Compete in a fiery arena to claim the Brimstone Crown.
Guardian of Y'ffelon: Go to Y'ffelon and stop the Firesong Circle.
Percussive Ranching: Help a kwama farmer gather his herd.
Peril at the Pools: Locate the farmers who were displaced by the Covenant invasion.
Pledge: Blessed Crucible: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Blessed Crucible.
Pledge: Volenfell: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Volenfell.
Proving Trust: Aid a town in the wake of a volcanic eruption.
Recovering the Guar: Locate the guar that ran away during the Covenant attack.
The Show Must Go On: Rescue the Dancing Scrib from the Steel Shrikes.
Season of Harvest: Participate in the Harvest Festival at Bad Man's Hallows.
Stem the Tide: Prevent a Covenant attack on Kragenmoor.
The Truth about Spiders: Figure out what is controlling the spiders in Hightide Hollow.
Unbridled Wealth: Recover a merchant's wares and her favorite guar.
summary: Shalks are aggressive giant beetles native to Morrowind. They attack with fire and can move through lava unharmed.
